scope: Seven inherited ambiguous or unsupported exact identities; not exhaustive manufacturer catalogs. No nonexistence claim or automatic product substitution.

crucial-c40-product.scope: Manufacturer endpoint returned Request Rejected. This is not a not-found response and does not prove the disputed CL36 product nonexistent.

teamgroup-expert-matrix.scope: Exact part-number rows in the current black EXPERT DDR5 matrix; a family selector does not establish every capacity/timing combination.

coolermaster-wattage-guide.scope: Named PSU families: V Gold i 750/850 are distinct from GX Gold 1050 and MWE Gold V2 1050. This is not an exhaustive worldwide V-series list.

coolermaster-masterplus.scope: Software-compatible-product table names V850/V750/V650 Gold i multi. It does not identify a 1050W model or establish that these are the only variants worldwide.

supermicro-sc745.scope: Exact CSE-745BAC-R1K23B-SQ specification: seven full-height/full-length slots and eight hot-swap 3.5/2.5-inch bays.

supermicro-sc747.scope: Exact CSE-747BTQ-R2K04B specification: eleven full-height/full-length slots, eight 3.5-inch hot-swap bays and a separately specified redundant PSU.

supermicro-1k69p.scope: Exact PWS-1K69P-1R module: 1000W at 100-127Vac, 1600W at 200-240Vac; gold-finger/backplane output and validated host systems. Not an ordinary ATX cable PSU.

supermicro-1k60d.scope: Different PWS-1K60D-1R 1600W module uses -48Vdc to -60Vdc input and 25-pair gold-finger output. Matching wattage/redundancy does not establish interchangeable input or mechanics.

seagate-firecuda540-datasheet.scope: DS2120.2-2304 retail table, page 2: 1TB ZP1000GM3A004 and 2TB ZP2000GM3A004. No 4TB row. This older document does not prove that no future or regional 4TB product can exist. Its standard-model table prints different model characters; no automatic SKU reconciliation is performed.

seagate-ironwolf-support.scope: Current non-Pro support matrix includes 18TB ST18000VN000 and smaller capacities; no 24TB row was established. Absence from this source is not a universal nonexistence claim.

seagate-ironwolf-pro-support.scope: Pro support matrix separately identifies 24TB ST24000NT002 and ST24000NT031. Neither establishes the inherited non-Pro record.
